userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/156.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/156.0.0.0
notes: Allegro Mini on the owner's Windows PC, in Edge. Connect; the app's own read-only register scan (0x20 to 0x70); EQ on; band 1 gain -0.1 dB; global gain to step 12; EQ off; EQ on; Save to flash, which drops USB about 40 ms after its answer and returns 850 ms later (HID disconnect at 92182.7 ms, connect at 93028.3 ms). Then back as found: band flat, step 13, a raw write of 3 to register 0x24 through the app's debug handle at 113603.9 ms, which the app's UI can't send, and a save (disconnect 113900.8 ms, connect 114753.2 ms). Eight events around 15460 ms are put back in request-then-answer order: the wrapper logged a send when it resolved, after a fast answer.
